_doc: PRESET: talking head. Auto rough cut (drops pauses) + word-timed captions + punch-ins + lower third + end card. Needs a transcript: python3 transcribe.py raw/<recording>.mp4  (writes raw/<recording>.words.json). Keys starting with _ are notes.
name: talking_head

scenes.name: talk
scenes._doc: transcript = word timings JSON. clip = optional source range to use. trim.mode: words (cut pauses > max_gap using the transcript), silence (ffmpeg silencedetect: noise_db, min_dur), none. cuts = extra [start,end] source ranges to remove by hand (e.g. a repeated take). captions: any key from style/signature.json 'caption' (size, y, max_words, uppercase, fixes{wrong:right}). punch_ins: [{at,dur,scale}] on the EDITED timeline; focus = [x,y] as fractions of the frame to zoom toward. lower_third: name/title, shown at 'at' for 'dur'. hud:false removes the corner brackets.
End card with no photo: title parts, subtitle, cta lines in the middle, two info lines, then the handle from style/signature.json.
scenes.subtitle: P H O T O  ·  V I D E O
